# gpupaas_workspace (Resource)

A workspace (`paas.envmgmt.io/v1` `Workspace`): a partition of a project that holds instances, SSH keys and security groups. Create it first and put the instances, SSH keys and security groups in it with `metadata.workspace`. A workspace that still holds instances (virtual machines, bare metal machines, clusters, volumes) cannot be deleted: delete them first. Its SSH keys and security groups are removed with it. It has metadata only: the platform accepts a readme and an icon but does not store them, so the provider does not offer them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A workspace is a partition of a project. Put instances, SSH keys and security groups in it with
# metadata.workspace. A workspace that still holds instances cannot be deleted: delete them first. Its SSH keys and security groups go with it.
resource "gpupaas_workspace" "team_a" {
  metadata = {
    name         = "team-a"
    project      = "system-catalog"
    display_name = "Team A"
    description  = "Shared by the team A engineers"
    labels       = { team = "a" }
  }
}
```
